- **Expected:** status 418 `"I'm a Teapot"`
- **Actual:** status 200 `"OK"`

The failure comes from an assertion in `test/res.send.js`, which has an uncommitted modification in the working tree (shown in the git status at the start of the session). I didn't read the file or change anything, so I can't say whether that edit causes the failure.

The output shown to me was shortened by a token-saver wrapper (`ojas`) that a session hook says is active for some shell commands. I ran `npm test` without piping or filtering, but that wrapper omitted about 1,900 lines of passing-test output. The failure section above is complete.
